<onlyinclude>
= Peer Review Protocol =

All concepts marked [[Category:Emerging]] or higher must undergo peer review before elevation to [[Category:Established]]. The review process involves:

= Validation by at least two domain experts =
= Cross-reference verification against existing knowledge =
= Epistemic status assessment using BITwiki criteria =
= Confidence category assignment (High, Medium, Low, Unverified, Contested) =
= Documentation of review decision in talk page =

Reviewers must declare conflicts of interest. Disputed evaluations escalate to the Epistemic Review Board.
</onlyinclude>
